## Purpose

Take a count of one shelf that a second person could repeat.

## Learning objectives

- Count a shelf left to right and write the number down before moving on.
- Recount and explain any difference.

## Theory

Counting twice is not about distrust. A second count that agrees is the evidence
that the first one was taken by a rule rather than by eye.

## Material in this lesson

The files beside this one are declared in the frontmatter and handed out by level.

## Completion conditions

`stockroom.csv` has a count for the first shelf, and you can explain how it was taken.
